select f.foster_id, f.foster_code, f.pet_id, f.client_id, f.foster_term, f.foster_money, f.foster_info, f.in_date, f.back_date, f.daily_fee, f.clean_fee, f.meal_fee, f.status, f.day_count, f.settle_money, f.deposit_used, f.refund_money, f.charge_money, f.adjust_note, f.bill_id, p.pet_name, c.client_name FROM foster f, pet p, client c WHERE f.is_del = 0 AND f.pet_id = p.pet_id AND f.client_id = c.client_id
and (c.client_name like #{clientKw} or c.client_tel like #{clientKw})
and (p.pet_name like #{petKw} or p.pet_variety like #{petKw})
ORDER BY f.foster_id DESC

SELECT f.foster_id, f.foster_code, f.pet_id, f.client_id, f.foster_term, f.foster_info, f.in_date, f.status, p.pet_name, p.pet_variety, p.pet_sex, p.pet_birthday, p.pet_status, p.pet_info, p.pet_photo FROM foster f, pet p WHERE f.is_del = 0 AND f.pet_id = p.pet_id AND f.status IN (0, 1)

select f.foster_id, f.foster_code, f.pet_id, f.client_id, f.foster_term, f.foster_money, f.foster_info, f.in_date, f.back_date, f.daily_fee, f.clean_fee, f.meal_fee, f.status, f.day_count, f.settle_money, f.deposit_used, f.refund_money, f.charge_money, f.adjust_note, f.bill_id, p.pet_name, c.client_name FROM foster f, pet p, client c WHERE f.is_del = 0 AND f.client_id = #{clientId} AND f.pet_id = p.pet_id AND f.client_id = c.client_id ORDER BY f.foster_id DESC LIMIT 100

mapper.update: UPDATE foster SET pet_id = #{petId}, client_id = #{clientId}, foster_term = #{fosterTerm}, foster_money = #{fosterMoney}, foster_info = #{fosterInfo}, in_date = #{inDate}, status = #{status}, daily_fee = #{dailyFee}, clean_fee = #{cleanFee}, meal_fee = #{mealFee}, update_time = NOW() WHERE foster_id = #{fosterId} AND is_del = 0
